mentions.name: Whistle Subtitles
mentions.description: This free app generates subtitles for multi-person videos and old movies using NVIDIA's Parakeet ASR model, with a European-language focus (e.g., English, French, German, Spanish, Polish, and more). It ships as offline installers for Linux, Windows, and macOS, and diarization-based speaker tagging is still in development.
mentions.problem: Subtitling old movies and multi-person videos to make them more accessible.
